description_good_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub#readme describes local web-security assessment, regression testing, and authorization requirements.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents forks, branches, focused pull requests, required checks and maintainer review.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for changed behavior, lint, strict type checks, audits, documentation and secret-free changes.
documentation_basics_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/docs/USER_MANUAL.md explain installation and use, with illustrated English/Japanese training.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/docs/SPECIFICATION.md documents API inputs/outputs, with scenario/configuration and report formats in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/docs/USER_MANUAL.md.
sites_https_justification: The website https://tip.co.jp/web-security-hub/, repository https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub and GitHub release downloads support HTTPS.
discussion_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues and https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/pulls are searchable, addressable web discussions open to participants with a GitHub account.
english_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/README.md, https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and the user manual are in English. English reports and comments are accepted.
maintained_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/commits/main shows ongoing maintenance, including automated tests and security updates in October 2026.
repo_track_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/commits/main provides Git authorship, timestamps and diffs.
repo_interim_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/commits/main includes incremental changes between releases and reviewed pull requests.
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git and GitHub.
version_unique_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/releases uses unique desktop-vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH release tags, matching package/native versions.
version_semver_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md specifies SemVer. Current published desktop release is desktop-v3.0.0.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/releases provide human-readable summaries rather than raw commit logs.
release_notes_vulns_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md identifies the fixed source-toolkit extract-zip advisory path by CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv and GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3, affected source users and upgrade requirements. Unreleased fixes are explicitly distinguished from existing installer assets; future release notes must identify applicable public CVE/GHSA fixes.
report_process_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md links https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues and asks for version, OS, reproduction steps and expected behavior.
report_responses_justification: As reviewed on 2026-10-19, https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues?state=all has no non-PR bug reports in the review period; there are no unacknowledged bug reports. The project is new; response history must be rechecked as reports arrive.
enhancement_responses_justification: As reviewed on 2026-10-19, https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues?state=all has no non-PR enhancement requests in the review period; there are no unanswered enhancement requests.
report_archive_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed and https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/issues preserve searchable reports and responses.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md explains reporting, triage, acknowledgement, coordinated fixes and disclosure.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/security/advisories/new is the private reporting form. Repository private vulnerability reporting was enabled and verified via GitHub API on 2026-10-19. Instructions are in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: As reviewed on 2026-10-19, no vulnerability reports are present in the repository security-advisory records. https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md requires acknowledgement within 14 days. Recheck this answer when a report is received.
build_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/package.json provides npm run build:verifier using TypeScript; source setup uses npm ci. Native packaging scripts and prerequisites are in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/docs/desktop/README.md.
build_common_tools_justification: Builds use npm, TypeScript, Rust/Cargo and Tauri with documented platform prerequisites.
build_floss_tools_justification: The source application uses FLOSS Node.js, npm, TypeScript and Playwright. https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md distinguishes source builds from optional platform-specific installer packaging and proprietary signing/notarization services.
test_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents npm test; https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/package.json invokes the FLOSS Node.js test runner. Tests are Apache-2.0 in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/tree/main/test.
test_invocation_justification: npm test is the standard test invocation, with TypeScript compilation in pretest.
test_most_justification: Most-branch coverage has not been measured. The automated suite covers important valid/invalid scenarios and security boundaries, but there is no claim of majority/all branch coverage or mobile hardware acceptance. This is a suggested criterion; documented limitations remain visible.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs tests on pushes, pull requests and weekly; installer workflows also run tests.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires automated tests for major features and changed behavior, failure cases, and regressions.
tests_are_added_justification: Latest major source-verifier changes include tests in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/test/verifierSast.test.js, https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/test/verifierSourceBinding.test.js and https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/test/verifierZap.test.js. The mobile dependency update adds a loopback W3C session regression test in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/test/mobileStepExecutor.test.js.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents the policy to add tests with feature and bug-fix contributions.
warnings_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/eslint.config.mjs enables ESLint recommended/error rules and security checks; strict TypeScript/noUncheckedIndexedAccess/noUnusedLocals are enabled in https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/tsconfig.verifier.json.
warnings_fixed_justification: npm run lint (--max-warnings 0) and npm run typecheck pass. The quality and release workflows fail on lint/type errors; warnings are addressed rather than ignored.
warnings_strict_justification: ESLint rejects warnings; TypeScript uses strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch and unused-code checks. Deliberately vulnerable training fixtures are identified separately from production code.
crypto_published_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md documents Node.js/OpenSSL crypto primitives, SHA-256 integrity, randomBytes/randomUUID tokens and standard TLS. The project implements no custom cryptographic algorithm.
crypto_call_justification: Cryptographic operations call Node.js crypto, standard TLS and platform libraries; there is no custom crypto implementation.
crypto_floss_justification: Node.js/OpenSSL, Rust libraries and the relevant source dependencies are FLOSS; source application cryptographic functionality does not require proprietary implementations. Apple notarization is an optional distribution service.
crypto_keylength_justification: Application authorization tokens and owned ZAP keys use 32 cryptographically random bytes (256 bits), evidence/download integrity uses SHA-256, and HTTPS uses maintained Node.js/OpenSSL default TLS security settings. The application does not generate asymmetric keys or offer a smaller token/key-length setting.
crypto_working_justification: Default security mechanisms use SHA-256, secure random capabilities and standard TLS. SHA-1 used for DOM/selector change fingerprints is non-security comparison, not authentication or download/evidence integrity; see SECURITY.md.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Security mechanisms do not depend on MD5, SHA-1 signatures, DES or RC4. Node.js/OpenSSL provides maintained TLS defaults; non-security DOM fingerprints are documented separately.
crypto_pfs_justification: External HTTPS uses Node.js/OpenSSL default TLS negotiation, which supports TLS 1.3 and ephemeral (EC)DHE cipher suites. Plain HTTP fixtures/authorized HTTP targets do not provide confidentiality and are documented as such; the project implements no separate key-agreement protocol.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The product does not store passwords to authenticate external users. Target-login credentials are local recoverable secrets used to authenticate to another service; this criterion explicitly excludes that use case. Synthetic training accounts are fixtures; see SECURITY.md.
crypto_random_justification: Authorization capabilities, local CSRF/session tokens and ZAP API keys use Node.js crypto.randomBytes/randomUUID rather than Math.random. See desktop/host.js, core/verifier/policies/index.js and core/verifier/typed/adapters/ownedZapRuntime.ts.
delivery_mitm_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/releases and source distribution use HTTPS. Managed tool downloads require HTTPS and pinned SHA-256 verification in core/verifier/typed/adapters/zapRuntimeInstall.ts.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release files/checksums are delivered via HTTPS, and managed tool checksums are committed in source obtained via HTTPS. No checksum retrieved over plain HTTP is trusted for software delivery.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Current source and desktop-runtime npm audits report 0 known advisories as of 2026-10-19. The vulnerable optional WebdriverIO dependency path was removed. No project security advisories are recorded; https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md requires timely fixes for confirmed medium-or-higher exploitable issues. This statement describes current reviewed source, not a guarantee about every previously distributed artifact. The Linux-only glib 0.18.5 VariantStrIter advisory (GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g / RUSTSEC-2024-0429) is fixed in the current source by the exact two-line upstream PR #1343 backport through a Cargo path patch. The optimized Rust regression test passes; original upstream provenance/license and patch removal conditions are documented in src-tauri/vendor/glib-0.18.5/PATCH.md. Unpatched historical copies are still affected.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No open critical dependency or project advisory was found in the 2026-10-19 review. https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/SECURITY.md prioritizes critical reports immediately and requires mitigation while preparing a fix.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret-scanning open alerts: 0. Local gitleaks redacted scan of all Git branches/tags/history: 0 findings (2026-10-19); release-content check also passed. Private configuration and artifacts remain ignored; scanners cannot prove absence of every secret.
static_analysis_justification: ESLint with security rules runs successfully via npm run lint. https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and installer workflows gate changes/releases; https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml adds JavaScript/TypeScript security-extended analysis.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: ESLint checks eval, implied eval, Function construction, child-process misuse, insecure random/Buffer usage and possible timing attacks. CodeQL security-extended analyzes JavaScript/TypeScript. Intentional vulnerable training fixtures are excluded from production scans.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Lint and type checks pass. https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires review/fixing of confirmed exploitable medium-or-higher static findings before a release; releases run the checks and may not suppress findings simply to obtain a badge. CodeQL security-extended analysis of PR #7 completed successfully with zero results (GitHub analysis 1981626047).
static_analysis_often_justification: https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs ESLint on every relevant branch push and all PRs; CodeQL runs on main/develop pushes, PRs and weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: npm test exercises real loopback HTTP routes, authorization/cancellation, browser-backed verifier behavior and W3C mobile session transport with assertions. Tests run before release builds. This is runtime testing, not a claim of complete fuzzing or real-device acceptance.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The Rust desktop shell contains small unsafe libc process-termination FFI blocks. AddressSanitizer/Valgrind coverage has not been established for those blocks; memory-safe JavaScript/TypeScript and loopback tests do not establish that coverage. This is a suggested criterion.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The Node.js suite uses node:assert/strict with assertions enabled; 141 tests passed in the local 2026-10-19 review, including negative inputs and authorization/cancellation assertions.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: All 141 automated tests pass in the local review. CONTRIBUTING.md requires timely fixes for confirmed exploitable medium-or-higher issues found by runtime analysis and passing tests before release; untested hardware/fuzzing coverage is not claimed.
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer (a professional systems engineer) applies secure-design principles visible in the code and docs: the tool runs locally, tests only authorized targets, verifies downloaded tools with pinned releases and SHA-256 checks, and CI runs npm audit (https://github.com/masahiroid/web-security-hub/tree/main/.github/workflows).
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer knows common vulnerability classes for web security tooling and desktop apps (injection, unsafe handling of untrusted input, vulnerable dependencies, tampered downloads) and counters them with authorization-only testing, pinned and checksum-verified downloads, tests in test/, and npm audit in CI.
